# Sunfish Design Token Reference

Per [ADR 0077 §5](../../../docs/adrs/0077-shared-design-system.md). Tokens follow [W3C Design Tokens format](https://design-tokens.github.io/community-group/format/). Custom properties use `--sf-*` prefix.

## Color Tokens

Each color token has explicit `-light` and `-dark` variants plus a responsive
default (`var(--sf-color-*-light)`) that switches to dark under
`prefers-color-scheme: dark` or `[data-theme="dark"]`.

|---|---|---|
